typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblGSFDailyBridgetableReport_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		GSF_ParentId as string,
		GSF_Weekly as timestamp,
		GSF_Trading_Unit_Name as string,
		GSF_EventType as string,
		GSF_Book as string,
		GSF_TradeVersion as string,
		Source as string,
		GSF_CreatedBy as string,
		GSF_Status as string,
		GSF_TicketId as string,
		GSF_Counterparty as string,
		GSF_AsOfDate as date,
		GSF_SourceSubSystem as string,
		GSF_Reasoncode as string,
		GSF_Entity as string,
		GSF_GsfMapKey as string,
		GSF_Fullname as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		GSF_ParentId as string,
		GSF_Weekly as string,
		GSF_Trading_Unit_Name as string,
		GSF_EventType as string,
		GSF_Book as string,
		GSF_TradeVersion as string,
		Source as string,
		GSF_CreatedBy as string,
		GSF_Status as string,
		GSF_TicketId as string,
		GSF_Counterparty as string,
		GSF_AsOfDate as string,
		GSF_SourceSubSystem as string,
		GSF_ReasonCode as string,
		GSF_Entity as string,
		GSF_GsfMapKey as string,
		GSF_Fullname as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		GSF_ParentId,
		GSF_Weekly,
		GSF_Trading_Unit_Name,
		GSF_EventType,
		GSF_Book,
		GSF_TradeVersion,
		Source,
		GSF_CreatedBy,
		GSF_Status,
		GSF_TicketId,
		GSF_Counterparty,
		GSF_AsOfDate,
		GSF_SourceSubSystem,
		GSF_ReasonCode = GSF_Reasoncode,
		GSF_Entity,
		GSF_GsfMapKey,
		GSF_Fullname),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblGSFDailyBridgetableReport_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblGSFDailyBridgetableReport
